value.summary: This pull request moves the `openhuman` module one level up (removing the redundant `openhuman::openhuman` prefix in import paths) and refactors the hive-mind episode loop to support concurrent rounds of multiple turns instead of single turns, with corresponding spec and test updates. The mechanics of the round loop look correct and the structural imports compile; no behavioural defects were found in the code directly visible in the diff.
